consuming_workflow: Contributors validate staged work, exact proposed candidates and current roadmap delivery status through the real read-only CLI and project-status selector.
intent: Reject unauthorized or unsupported delivery transitions with usable diagnostics, exact snapshot identity and no automatic repair or acceptance.
scope: Read-only validator entry points and their complete success/refusal matrix in isolated infrastructure fixtures. Prepared candidate contract; actual readiness, enrollment, independent proof and activation remain separate.
exclusions: No native EDA acceptance, Preferences takeover, prototype change or dependency. Real owner-hook and promotion-tooling verification remain additional I03/WDQ-REVIEW obligations; installed activation and three native adoption cohorts are not satisfied by this contract.

units_precision.reason: No CAD geometry or unit conversion; control IDs and hashes are not CAD precision.

numeric_entry.reason: No CAD numeric entry; malformed control values are separately tested as validation inputs.

selection_identity.reason: No CAD selection or stable design subject; Frontier identity is control authority, not product selection.

grid_snap.reason: No authored or snapped coordinate, grid setting or editor consumer.

undo_cancel.reason: Refusal and interruption preserve state; no design undo capability is claimed.

persistence_recovery.reason: Protected source/index/refs/trust survive refusal and interruption; a fresh invocation succeeds. No native Save claim.

library_connectivity.reason: No authored library binding, net or connectivity model.

settings_scope.reason: Read only explicitly selected repository-local trust and requested snapshot; no Global Preferences acceptance.

consumers.scope: Explicit isolated repository, externally selected trust and requested snapshot only.
consumers.timing: Validate before reporting a permitted transition; return actual findings without repairing inputs.
consumers.persistence: Read-only protected repository state; owned diagnostic logs and derived caches recorded separately.
consumers.unavailable_reason: Missing or inconsistent authority, inputs or evidence produces a structured refusal; never a fabricated success.

scenarios.preconditions: Complete valid isolated enrolled fixture plus malformed invocation; exact assembled candidate and externally selected fixture trust.
inputs: Invoke the real staged CLI, exact-candidate CLI and project-status selector on valid inputs; retain arguments, stdout/stderr and status.
Repeat with an invalid invocation, and distinguish diagnostic report-only from enforcing mode.
scenarios.expected_visible: Valid inputs succeed with no findings and preserve the selected step; invalid input gives a readable reason and nonzero enforcement status. No color or GUI is required.
scenarios.expected_state: Readiness and acceptance flags remain false; snapshot, selection authority and protected repository state are unchanged.
